import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import refcompile, brute, pipeline
random.seed(4242)
bad=0; trials=0; tie=0
for trial in range(60):
    n=random.choice([0,1,2,3,5,8])
    seen=set(); entries=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        length=random.choice([0,1,2,3,8,16,24,32,33,64,96,120,128])
        addr=pipeline.trunc(random.getrandbits(128),length)
        if (addr,length) in seen: continue
        seen.add((addr,length)); entries.append((addr,length,random.randrange(65536)))
    S=4
    caps=[random.choice([64,128,256,512,1024,4096]) for _ in range(S)]
    ms=random.choice([4,8,16,32])
    ref=refcompile.compile_ref(entries,caps,ms)
    req={'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':pipeline.canonical_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in entries],
         'capacities':caps,'max_stride':ms}
    got=pipeline.do_compile(req)
    trials+=1
    if ref is None:
        if got.get('status')!='infeasible':
            bad+=1; print('MISMATCH status', trial, entries, caps, ms, ref, got)
        continue
    if got.get('status')!='ok':
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH status2', trial, entries, caps, ms, ref, got); continue
    if got['cuts']!=ref['cuts']: tie+=1
    if got['used_bits']!=ref['used_bits']:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH used', trial, entries, caps, ms, got['used_bits'], ref['used_bits']); break
    if got['peak']!=ref['peak']:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH peak', trial, got['peak'], ref['peak']); break
    if got['stages']!=ref['stages']:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH stages', trial)
        print(json.dumps(got['stages'],indent=1)[:1500]); print(json.dumps(ref['stages'],indent=1)[:1500]); break
print('compile reference check done, trials=%d mismatches=%d cutdiffs=%d' % (trials,bad,tie))
